label: Security Posture Pro
summary: Advanced cross-service posture review, exception tracking, evidence comparison and source-attributed policy recommendations. Optional scanners and advisory providers feed bounded findings rather than automatically changing server configuration.
core_boundary: All baseline security, hardening, secrets, tenant isolation and compliance controls required by the 233 capabilities remain free Core duties. This module adds comparative assessments and exception workflows; a PRO entitlement cannot relax the Core security floor.
acceptance: Record engine/version/source/time for every finding and distinguish measured facts, advisory applicability and recommendations.
Qualify selected checks against safe synthetic fixtures and prevent unrestricted file/network/process inspection.
Bind any proposed remediation to its resource owner and current permission, with explicit diff, risk and recovery evidence.
Test revoked authority, stale findings, false positives and provider outages without claiming a host is secure.
Removal must preserve mandatory Core protections, local incident visibility and authorized baseline remediation.
